blank.description: The process is recorded but not reconstructed yet. The canvas comes out of the discussion: describe the process to the agent and it will propose the BPMN. You can also import a .bpmn file, or draw it by hand from the palette on the left.

review.title: Process Review
review.readOnlyTask: Review actions keep the As-Is unchanged.
review.noStructuralGaps: No structural gaps in the available fields. Timing and quality still need assessment.
review.suggestionGaps: Clarify missing information with the owner before proposing a change.
review.suggestionComplete: Assess evidence and dependencies; document a proposal before building the To-Be.
review.noPlanDescription: Owner, inputs and outputs are shown only when documented in the plan or BPMN.

actionDescription.candidate: Create a To-Be hypothesis for “{{name}}”. The As-Is diagram remains unchanged.
actionDescription.clarification: Record a question for “{{name}}” in the review log. The owner still needs to be asked.
actionDescription.deferred: Defer the verification of “{{name}}” and record why. Evidence remains visible.

detailLabel.candidate: Proposed change and impacts to verify

detailPlaceholder.candidate: Describe what to change, why and which dependencies to verify…
detailPlaceholder.clarification: What information is needed to decide?
detailPlaceholder.deferred: Why defer and when should verification resume?

review.staleDescription: Refresh the review and reassess the task before recording a new action.
review.noEvidenceDescription: The diagram does not link this task to a verifiable plan element. Missing evidence is not proof of an error.
review.dependencyDescription: Highlighting follows real BPMN flows upstream and downstream, including branches and cycles. It shows a verification scope, not an established impact.
review.noDependencies: No linked activities in this direction.
review.performanceDescription: No timing change has been calculated in this review. An estimate requires a scenario, validated parameters and a simulation run. Check responsibilities of linked tasks too.
review.actionsDescription: Hypotheses, questions and deferrals recorded for this task. A proposal does not change the model.
review.toBeEyebrow: As-Is describes · Review interprets · To-Be transforms
review.hypothesesDescription: Review hypotheses are the starting point for the To-Be. The consultant must assess them before turning them into a new model.
review.noCandidatesDescription: Inspect a task and record a proposal with evidence and impacts to verify.
review.findingsScope: Findings for the entire process: they are not automatically assigned to the selected task.
review.emptyDescription: Review starts from a saved diagram. Reconstruct the process or import a BPMN before inspecting tasks.
review.selectHint: Select a task on the canvas or open the Tasks list to begin.
